title: TopWords language pack (schema_version 1)
description: Structural contract for a TopWords language pack. This schema enforces the type/enum/shape layer of docs/language-pack-schema.md (VR-1, VR-6, VR-7, and the non-empty/format parts of VR-5/VR-8/VR-9). Rules that JSON Schema cannot express are enforced by the Phase 6 pipeline validator, NOT here: VR-2 (word_count == entry count), VR-3 (id unique across entries), VR-4 (id == {language_code}:{lemma}:{pos}), VR-5 (rank unique), VR-10 (the example-sentence frequency constraint), VR-11 (base_language required when a gloss exists), VR-12 (audio refs resolve), VR-13 (aliases globally unique), VR-16 (language_code matches manifest + id prefixes), VR-17/VR-18 (shippable-profile 1000-word rules). A pack passing this schema is well-formed, not necessarily shippable.

schema_version.description: Major version of this contract. This schema file validates version 1 only.

pack_version.description: Semver of this pack's content, independent of schema_version.

base_language.description: Language the gloss values are written in. Required (by the pipeline validator, VR-11) when any entry has a gloss.

word_count.description: Number of entries. Pipeline enforces == entry count (VR-2) and == 1000 for shippable packs (VR-17).

id.description: {language_code}:{lemma}:{pos}. Exact derivation is checked by the pipeline (VR-4); this is a shape check only.

pos.description: Universal POS tag. Entry-valid set only: no PROPN/PUNCT/SYM/X/SPACE (VR-6).

allOf.$comment: VR-7: is_function_word must equal (pos in CLOSED_CLASS).
